name: JF Kitchen And Events

reviews.name: Anand Rapheal
reviews.quote: This caterer consistently provides exceptional, delicious, and hygienically prepared food, offers convenient door-to-door delivery, and expertly manages all event details. I have been a satisfied customer for many years.

reviews.name: ABIN JOSE
reviews.quote: Delicious and authentic food with professional services, thank for your support to make this event more enjoyable and stress free.

reviews.name: Nitin Pradhan
reviews.quote: Though the food is tasty but the price in swiggy is way to much in comparison to the restaurant rate. I order through swiggy around 2 items and paid the amount but when I checked the restaurant in Google i found out their original price which was half of the amount which I paid to swiggy.
